proposed_tranches.name: Current authority normalization
actions: change test_governance_authority state from candidate to promoted/active
make current authority manifest the single machine-readable source for active lifecycle profile names
classify TG-2 semantic profile manifest as historical migration evidence without rewriting its historical facts

actions: remove 10 completed milestone-specific workflow YAML files from .github/workflows
retain five CI_POLICY_V1 workflows
verify validate_github_actions_execution_policy returns passed and workflow_count=5
do not delete acceptance ledgers or run IDs

actions: remove redundant tg2-default-ci-current-shadow alias after all current references migrate to default-ci

introduce stable historical milestone replay name for the 94-node historical lifecycle
introduce stable release lifecycle name for the 5-node release profile
retain pre-tg5-default-ci rollback diagnostic until a later explicit rollback-retirement decision
retain mixed-historical diagnostic until mixed files are intentionally split

proposed_tranches.name: Selective marker adoption
actions: apply lifecycle markers only where node-level distinction is required
use markers for future tests from creation time

proposed_tranches.name: Optional historical physical cleanup
actions: do not move the 15 historical tests initially
do not rewrite accepted ledgers to new paths

proposed_tranches.name: Optional milestone validator retirement

keep ledgers immutable
remove only validators with no current authority role and no unique reproducibility value

stop_rules: No change may alter default-ci 778-node authority without a separate authority-change gate.

Do not remove the only test protecting a current security, identity, fail-closed, compatibility or contract invariant.
